definitions.explanation: Having the ability to act, speak, or think without restrictions or constraints.
The state of being free; the power to act without constraint.

notes:
{自由|じゆう} functions as both a na-adjective (free, unrestricted) and a noun (freedom, liberty).

FORMS:
- Attributive: {自由|じゆう}な + noun ({自由|じゆう}な{時間|じかん} — free time)
- Adverbial: {自由|じゆう}に ({自由|じゆう}に{使|つか}う — to use freely)
- Predicate: {自由|じゆう}だ/です

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {自由席|じゆうせき}: unreserved seat
- {不自由|ふじゆう}: inconvenience; disability
- {自由|じゆう}{研究|けんきゅう}: independent research (school project)
- {言論|げんろん}の{自由|じゆう}: freedom of speech
- {自由|じゆう}{貿易|ぼうえき}: free trade

COLLOCATIONS:
- {自由|じゆう}を{求|もと}める: to seek freedom
- {自由|じゆう}に{行動|こうどう}する: to act freely
- {自由|じゆう}を{奪|うば}う: to take away freedom
